column1: # Check platforms of the PR gate, all run as the FAN-OUT body (round-2,
# 2026-10-22): the CRAN-shape build+check with the serial test phase
# displaced (--no-tests), one R CMD INSTALL of the tree shared by the K
# parallel attested testthat shards, the Rd-examples leg carried by the
# check phase and the vignette leg by the build phase of that same step
# (measured, /tmp/ciopt2/logs/probe-*). Every check arm now fans out: the
# single-process monolithic check -- full test phase, CRAN gates -- no
# longer vetoes PRs on an 81-minute serial leg; it rides the scheduled gate
# (.github/workflows/scheduled.yml, cran-shape-check).
# Consumed by the guard-prep matrix emission, the fan-out attestation
# census (--fanout-configs/--expect-config) and gated by
# tests/testthat/test-ci-shard-map.R + tools/ci-selfcheck.py.
# One 'os<TAB>config' row per arm; order is part of the committed witness
# (deterministic: os alphabetical, config in the retired matrix's order
# within an os -- release first, then the Linux specials, oldrel-1 last).
# Issue #76 (2026-11-05, docs/devlog/2026-11-05-ci-pr-gate-tiering-
# ruling.md): the PR gate keeps the three release-R arms -- every other
# per-push check arm was measurement, not signal, next to them. The five
# version arms moved verbatim to the nightly R-CMD-check-version-fanout
# job (.github/workflows/scheduled.yml, roster
# tools/ci/scheduled-fanout-configs.tsv); their tier-T1 battery gained a
# release-R witness there. Eight arms remain the committed census --
# three per push, six nightly, ubuntu/release standing in both gates.
